_meta.no_deed_text: No Deed Book Found or Provided
_meta.deed_formats: sourceref is the deed reference from the assessor. Most counties use book/page ("649/895"); many use year/instrument ("2020/13954", "2016/R000894"); some add letters ("D116/535", "E15/67", "N-169/299", "2026R/5087"); Ashley and Drew pack the chain of deeds in one string separated by " --- ". sourcedate is the deed date. Placeholders "0", "0/0", "/" are not counted.
_meta.plat_formats: No plat book/page field in the statewide layer; subdivision name is in subdivision and the legal in parcellgl.
_meta.excluded_false_hits: ArcGIS Online parcel layers from cities, NWARPC, Garver, Metroplan, Tontitown, Centerton, Pea Ridge, UARK, SWU and survey firms: copies of the AGISO or county data, not used. Desha "MISSING_PARCEL" and Dallas "RSR study area" are partial-area extracts.

status_legend.ok: owner+deed+PID live-verified countywide, deed reference filled on at least 50% of parcels
status_legend.partial: owner+PID with no deed, or deed under 50%
status_legend.missing: no public countywide owner source found

control.agency: NOAA NGS; Arkansas DOT (ARDOT) Surveys Division GPS control and ARDOT CORS/RTN; AGISO-hosted PLSS corner control (Arkansas Land Survey records)

sources.name: NGS Datasheets Feature Service (ALL_DATASHEETS), STATE='AR'
sources.county_filter: STATE='AR' AND COUNTY='<COUNTY UPPERCASE, no periods>' (e.g. 'ST FRANCIS', 'HOT SPRING')
sources.live_test: OK 2026-10-19: 11,291 AR marks, 26 with CORS_ID; every county's marks are in one zone

sources.name: ARDOT GPS control (AGISO Location/ARDOT_GPS_CONTROL)
sources.agency: Arkansas Department of Transportation, Surveys Division
sources.native_sr: EPSG:26915 (NAD83 UTM 15N); lat/long, ellipsoid and geoid heights in attributes
sources.note: Layer looks older than ARDOT's own downloads: ARDOT posts "ARDOT GPS & BM's" PDFs (zip) updated September 2026 at https://ardot.gov/divisions/surveys/control-surveys/. Many marks carry Geoid 12A heights. County names in the layer are mixed case and include out-of-state ties (e.g. "MO / TANEY").

sources.name: PLSS corner control points (AGISO Planning_Cadastre/PLSS_CORNER_CONTROL_POINTS)
sources.agency: Arkansas Land Survey corner records (Commissioner of State Lands), hosted by AGISO
sources.note: Section and quarter corners with surveyor, plat number and record date; useful for PLSS ties. cnty is the alphabetical county number (1 Arkansas ... 75 Yell).

cors_network.name: ARDOT CORS / ARDOT RTN
cors_network.stations: 39 ARDOT CORS in Arkansas (ARBT Batesville ... ARWY Wynne), plus partner MoDOT and LA DOTD border stations
cors_network.rtn: http://gps.ardot.gov/ (NTRIP, account and user agreement required; offered free as a public service per the ARCORS user agreement)
cors_network.raw_data: Reference Data Shop at gps.ardot.gov for stations not published with NGS
cors_network.note: not signed up; no account created

control.source_name: NOAA NGS Datasheets (AR) + ARDOT GPS control + PLSS corners

roads.name: Arkansas Centerline File (ACF), AGISO Transportation/ROADS_ACF
roads.agency: Arkansas GIS Office with county 911 addressing (ACF statewide road centerline program)
roads.county_filter: cn_l_fips = '<3-digit county FIPS>' (or cn_r_fips); comm_l/comm_r hold names like 'Arkansas County'
roads.schema: Address ranges (pl_add_f/t, pr_add_f/t), city/zip by side, ARDOT route keys (ah_*)
roads.vintage: date_ed 2024-01-04 to 2026-07-01 (a few typo dates of 2028-05-01); per-county latest date in roads_by_fips.json
roads.live_test: OK 2026-10-19: 458,050 segments, 458,048 with pstr_fulnam; 75 counties present (17,864 segments with no county FIPS)
roads.why: Statewide public named centerline layer for all 75 counties, kept current from county 911 addressing.
